_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Use when auditing a route, defining a route contract, reviewing onboarding or setup flows, diagnosing why a page feels…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "this onboarding flow feels confusing — analyze the task structure"
cases.context: The agent has access to the task-analysis skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is task-analysis the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes task-analysis as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against interaction-feedback, visual-design-foundations, diagnosis
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the task-analysis workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore task-analysis
Does not route to interaction-feedback, visual-design-foundations, diagnosis when the task-analysis scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
